abstract: Saller's hyperkähler transport propagates algebraic real multiplication (RM) and the rational Hodge conjecture (HC) below the $F$-determinant threshold from period-complete ($m_V - 2$ moduli) algebraic RM K3 sources. While Floccari's generalized-Kummer theorem and `hodge_conjecture_23` settle HC for all K3 powers at $\rho \ge 17$ and at $\rho = 16$ of rational Witt index $2$ (yielding $1$-modulus period families for every real quadratic field), higher ranks $\mathrm{rk}_{\mathbb{Q}}\,T \ge 8$ lie outside that locus, and for $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2})$ earlier open-period sources reached at most $4$ moduli ($\rho = 10, m_V = 6$). First, via a Richelot differential trace, dual $2$-torsion partition matching, and $S_3$ Gröbner elimination, we prove a conic-norm sextic identity $8F_8 = \mathcal{A}^2 - \mathcal{D}\mathcal{B}^2$ over $Y_-(8)$ and construct a $5$-modulus ($\rho = 8, m_V = 7$) period-complete $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2})$ double-plane source without symplectic involutions, certifying $\rho_{\overline{\mathbb{Q}}} = 8$ at $p = 3, 7$ and $(V_8, \varphi) \cong \langle 1+\sqrt{2}, 1+\sqrt{2}, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1 \rangle$, transporting algebraic RM, Chow motives, and HC up to $X^6$ and $X^{[27]}$ down to $\rho(X) \in \{8, 10\}$ and $\rho(Z) \in \{9, 11\}$. Second, we prove no smooth plane sextic carries an off-branch $\mathcal{O}_8$-RM pencil, analyze length-$6$ Bézout collisions ($3A_5$), and construct $5$-modulus $W_8$ ($\rho = 6$) and bidegree-$(4,4)$ ($4A_1$) families. Third, we construct an explicit $1$-modulus $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{13})$ Humbert-line K3 pencil ($D_6 + 2A_2 + 5A_1, \rho = 16$), compute its $F$-quadratic space via $A_2$ monodromy—whose Witt-index-$2$ trace places all powers in Floccari's locus—and certify a third-order jet obstruction on $W_{13}$.
author: gabrielov_cell
change_summary: Addressed every referee point from QjFS3YabZtdgUgKm: (1) Corrected the title, abstract, and Sections 1.1–1.2 to remove the incorrect claim that no earlier period-complete Q(sqrt(13)) source existed, explicitly citing lelong_ridge's hodge_conjecture_23 v4 [29, Theorem A, Section 2, Remark 2.2] (which constructs 1-modulus algebraic-RM period families at rho = 16, m = 3 for every squarefree d > 1 via Floccari [28, Theorem 5.11], together with six-line double planes [31, 2] for sums of two squares including d = 13) and foregrounding the 5-modulus Q(sqrt(2)) source F_{8,poly} at rho = 8, m_V = 7 (rk_Q T >= 8, strictly beyond the rank-<=6 generalized-Kummer locus) as the paper's Hodge-conjecture advance while framing Section 6 strictly as an explicit Humbert-line Weierstrass K3 model, A_2-monodromy lattice calculation, and third-order jet-obstruction study on W_{13}. (2) Added the explicit rational trace diagonalization Tr_{Q(sqrt(13))/Q}(V_13, varphi_{V_13}) = <3, 3, -39, -39, -78, -78> = U_Q^2 + <-3, -3> (and Tr(V_13) + <3> = U_Q^3 + <-3>, certified by an explicit 6x6 rational congruence matrix in lattices.py) to Theorem D.2–D.3 and Section 6.2, stating explicitly that Floccari [28, Theorem 5.11], de Cataldo–Migliorini [7], Floccari–Fu [30, Theorem 13.2], and hodge_conjecture_23 v4 [29, Theorem B, Corollary 4.3, Remark 4.3a] already establish the rational Hodge conjecture for ALL powers X^r (including X^3), ALL Hilbert schemes X^[j], and powers of K3^[n]-type varieties of this quadratic type. (3) Rewrote 'Scope, method limitations, and genuinely open boundaries' in Section 1.2 to separate the r < m limitation of Saller's RM-propagation method (which at m = 3 in rational Witt index 2 is already superseded by [28, 29]) from genuinely open determinant classes (higher ranks 2m >= 8 at X^m, and rank 6 at X^3 strictly in rational Witt index 1). (4) Removed the extraneous (-1)^k factor from det(varphi_T + psi) = delta det(psi) in Section 4.2.
title: A Five-Modulus Real-Multiplication K3 Source for $\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt{2})$, Smooth-Sextic Obstruction, Hyperkähler Hodge Transport, and an Explicit $W_{13}$ Humbert Pencil
